description: Late-endgame detector: fires when columns 0 and 3 are both full, at least three columns are full, and I (the player to move) have no immediate win and appear lost or stuck, typically because a remaining open column (often 1 or 5) has the opponent's threat cell right above my landing cell, or only one move is left. Weak or silent when column 0 or 3 is still open or when I have a winning move.
effect: Small. Forcing it high raises column 4 by about 2-24 points and slightly lowers columns 3 and 5; zeroing it in firing positions shifts move probabilities by under 5 points.
notes: Dev F1: p1 col0&col3 full + >=4 full 0.42; any poisoned move 0.12; poisoned + >=4 full 0.27; col0&3 + poisoned + no win 0.49; + 'hopeless' 0.49; relax to >=3 full 0.517 (best, P0.40 R0.72, AUROC 0.84, sim share 0.36). Without hopeless clause F1 0.49 (R0.81). Minimal pairs: col0 at height 5 instead of 6 collapses activation; one extra stone (flipping who is to move) swings it 9 -> 0 and back, matching whether my landing cell sits under their threat. Teacher scores: non-firing late positions usually have a winning move for me. Parity/zugzwang aspect only approximated; synthesis did not beat dev max (best 10.46).
